evidence_status: paper-reported; not reproduced by this repository

definitions.overall_quality: Equal mean of EnterpriseRAG-Bench mean(document recall, correctness, completeness), WixQA mean(context recall, factuality), and HERB content; includes both retrieval and answer quality.
definitions.relative_input_tokens: Geometric mean of within-benchmark input-token ratios to Raw Corpus for each model.
definitions.quality_gain: Table 6 paper-reported paired-bootstrap aggregate-quality difference; tiny deviations from subtracting rounded Table 1 entries are consistent with rounding.
definitions.scope: Four GPT models and three selected benchmark subsets; per-benchmark Table 1 effectiveness means and standard deviations use three runs. These intervals test aggregate quality, not token savings.

qualifications: Aggregate savings do not imply savings on every dataset/model or question.
Table 2 MAI-Thinking-1 has higher quality and more input tokens than Raw Corpus.
Table 8 no-candidate CorpusMap has higher quality and more input tokens than Raw Corpus.
Input-token ratios do not include offline construction cost.
Official project and code links have not been verified.
